hero.tagline: Big Venue, Big Game, Big Texas Energy
hero.description: Dallas hosts matches at AT&T Stadium in Arlington — the largest indoor stadium in the world, with a retractable roof and a screen that defines excess in the best possible way. Texas football culture and global football collide at the grandest scale imaginable.

stadium.name: AT&T Stadium
stadium.transport: AT&T Stadium is in Arlington, between Dallas and Fort Worth. No rail reaches the stadium — rideshare, shuttles, or driving are required. Game-day shuttles are expected from the Centerpoint shuttle hub. Allow 45–60 minutes from downtown Dallas on match days.

quick_facts.fan_hub_status: Fan hub expected at Main Street Garden Park in downtown Dallas

weather.june: Hot with highs around 33–36°C (91–97°F). Low humidity by Texas standards but still very warm. Thunderstorms possible.
weather.july: Very hot, highs 35–38°C (95–100°F). The stadium's retractable roof means match weather is controlled regardless.
packing_tips: Pack light, breathable fabrics — linen and moisture-wicking are essential
Sunscreen and a hat for outdoor fan events
A light layer for the stadium itself — the air conditioning inside AT&T is aggressive
Carry a water bottle — dehydration risk is real at outdoor events in Texas summer

airports.name: Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport
airports.distance_to_stadium: About 17 km to AT&T Stadium in Arlington
transfer_options: DART Orange Line connects Terminal A to downtown Dallas (Irving/Las Colinas area) — no direct train to Arlington
Rideshare from DFW to AT&T Stadium takes 20–30 minutes outside match-day traffic
Rental car is practical for DFW if you plan to explore the wider metro
airports.notes: Major international hub — likely port of entry for most international visitors. Closest major airport to AT&T Stadium. Rideshare to the stadium is practical from DFW.

airports.name: Dallas Love Field
transfer_options: DART Orange Line from nearby area connects to Downtown Dallas
Rideshare from Love Field to Dallas hotels is efficient — 15–20 min to downtown
airports.notes: Domestic airport close to Downtown Dallas. Southwest Airlines hub. Good option if staying downtown rather than near the stadium.

match_schedule.teams_or_placeholder: AT&T Stadium hosts multiple matches. Full schedule after group draw.

public_transit: No direct rail service to AT&T Stadium — it's in Arlington, outside the DART system
Game-day shuttles expected from designated collection points — confirm details closer to match day
DART Trinity Railway Express (TRE) runs between downtown Dallas and Fort Worth, with stops near Arlington — last-mile connection required
rideshare: Rideshare is the most practical option to AT&T Stadium from Dallas or Fort Worth hotels
Book a scheduled Uber or Lyft before the match to secure pricing
Post-match surge from AT&T Stadium is severe — walk to a side street or wait 30 minutes
driving_parking: AT&T Stadium has extensive parking — pre-book preferred lots online
Premium lots on Collins St are closest to the gates
Texas weather can include sudden storms — plan for wet lot walking
walking_biking: Not walkable from Dallas or Fort Worth hotels — the stadium sits alone in Arlington
Cycling from Arlington hotels or entertainment area is possible on quiet roads
match_day_tips: The stadium roof controls weather — look up whether it's open or closed before deciding what to wear
AT&T Stadium has one of the biggest videoboards in the world — the pre-match show is worth arriving early for
Parking lots near the stadium fill fast — arrive 2 hours before kickoff if driving
Arlington's entertainment district (AT&T Stadium area) has restaurants and bars for pre-match

fan_hubs.name: Dallas Fan Hub — Main Street Garden
fan_hubs.location: Main Street Garden Park, 1902 Main St, Dallas, TX
fan_hubs.description: A major fan hub expected in the heart of downtown Dallas, with giant screens, food vendors, live entertainment, and easy access from Downtown Dallas hotels and the DART rail system.
transport_tips: DART Green/Orange Lines to Akard or St. Paul station — walking distance to the park
Walking distance from many Downtown Dallas hotels

fan_hubs.name: Sundance Square Fan Block
fan_hubs.description: Fort Worth's vibrant entertainment plaza is expected to host watch parties throughout the tournament. Outdoor screens, restaurants, and bars line the pedestrianised plaza.
transport_tips: TRE commuter rail to Fort Worth Central station, short walk to Sundance Square
Rideshare from Dallas takes about 35–40 minutes

neighborhoods.name: Downtown Dallas
neighborhoods.best_for: Hotels, business district access, DART connections
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Safe during the day and around Klyde Warren Park area. Use rideshare for late-night travel.
neighborhoods.stadium_access: Rideshare or shuttle to Arlington — 35–45 min without match-day traffic
neighborhoods.description: Best hotel base for DART access, the expected downtown fan hub, and Klyde Warren Park. Wide range of major hotel brands with good pricing.

neighborhoods.name: Uptown Dallas
neighborhoods.safety_transit_notes: Safe, upscale, very active at night.
neighborhoods.description: The most vibrant neighborhood for evening out in Dallas. McKinney Ave, West Village, and Knox-Henderson all have great bars and restaurants within walking distance.

neighborhoods.name: Arlington / Entertainment District
neighborhoods.stadium_access: Walking distance to AT&T Stadium (depending on hotel)
neighborhoods.description: Stay here if your priority is being close to the stadium. The Arlington Entertainment District has Globe Life Field (baseball), AT&T Stadium, and several hotels within walking distance. Not a vibrant neighbourhood otherwise.

hotels.name: Omni Dallas Hotel
hotels.best_for: Downtown access, convention center, luxury amenities

hotels.name: Sheraton Dallas Hotel
hotels.best_for: Large groups, convention space, central location

hotels.name: Hotel Crescent Court
hotels.best_for: Luxury, Uptown nightlife access, boutique experience

bars.name: The Flying Saucer
bars.notes: Enormous craft beer hall in Fort Worth's Sundance Square. Great soccer atmosphere and incredible beer selection.

bars.name: House of Blues Dallas
bars.notes: Live music venue that becomes a serious match-day watch party destination. Expect a loud, energetic crowd.
bars.transit: DART Green Line to Deep Ellum

bars.name: The Rustic
bars.notes: Large outdoor venue in Uptown. Perfect for afternoon matches with a Texas BBQ and outdoor bar vibe.

bars.name: The Union Dallas
bars.notes: Outdoor food hall with multiple bars and screens. Pre-match gathering spot near the American Airlines Center.

bars.name: Katy Trail Ice House
bars.notes: Open-air biergarten next to the Katy Trail. One of Dallas's most popular outdoor bars for afternoon events.

transport.summary: Dallas–Fort Worth is car-dependent. The DART light rail serves downtown Dallas and DFW Airport but does not reach AT&T Stadium in Arlington. Rideshare is the most practical match-day option.
tips: Book rideshare in advance — match-day surge from AT&T Stadium hits $60–100+ immediately after full time
DART Green/Orange Line from DFW Airport to Downtown Dallas and Victory Park area
TRE (Trinity Railway Express) connects Dallas and Fort Worth — useful for Sundance Square
Rental car is practical if you plan to visit multiple suburbs or Fort Worth
Arlington has zero public transit — plan all in/out logistics by car, rideshare, or shuttle

fan_zones.name: Dallas Fan Hub — Main Street Garden
fan_zones.location: Main Street Garden Park, 1902 Main St, Dallas
fan_zones.description: Downtown Dallas fan hub with big screens, food vendors, and live entertainment throughout the tournament.

fan_zones.name: Sundance Square Fan Block
fan_zones.description: Fort Worth's pedestrian plaza expected to host watch parties with outdoor screens and a strong local crowd.

soccer_culture.community_notes: Dallas has a passionate soccer community driven by FC Dallas, a deep Hispanic football culture, and strong MLS support. The Cotton Bowl hosted the 1994 World Cup — the region has experience with tournament-scale events.

tourist_hits.name: Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza
tourist_hits.notes: JFK assassination site and museum in Downtown Dallas. Moving and historically significant.

tourist_hits.name: Klyde Warren Park
tourist_hits.notes: Urban park deck over the freeway in Downtown. Great food trucks and outdoor space.

tourist_hits.name: Deep Ellum
tourist_hits.notes: Dallas's arts and music district — murals, live music venues, and great bars.

tourist_hits.name: AT&T Discovery District
tourist_hits.notes: Downtown plaza with interactive art installations and screens. Free entry.

local_favorites.name: Perot Museum of Nature and Science
local_favorites.notes: World-class science museum in Downtown — excellent for families.

local_favorites.name: Bishop Arts District
local_favorites.notes: Independent shops, restaurants, and galleries in Oak Cliff. The most creative neighbourhood in Dallas.

local_favorites.name: Dallas Arboretum
local_favorites.notes: Stunning lakeside garden — beautiful in early morning before the heat.

areas: Uptown / Knox-Henderson — upscale restaurants and cocktail bars
Deep Ellum — music, arts, and food with a younger crowd
Bishop Arts District — independent restaurants and neighborhood bars
Sundance Square (Fort Worth) — entertainment plaza with restaurants and outdoor spaces

recommendations.name: Pecan Lodge
recommendations.notes: Legendary Dallas BBQ in Deep Ellum. Long lines but worth every minute.

recommendations.name: Uchi Dallas
recommendations.notes: World-class Japanese cuisine on Cedar Springs. Book well ahead.

recommendations.name: Monarch
recommendations.notes: Rooftop restaurant at the Thompson Hotel with panoramic city views.

local_resources.emergency_info: Emergency: 911. Non-emergency Dallas Police: (214) 744-4444. Hospital: UT Southwestern Medical Center, (214) 633-5200.

walk_bike.walkability_summary: Dallas is car-centric but Downtown, Uptown, and Deep Ellum are walkable within their zones. Klyde Warren Park and McKinney Ave are pleasant pedestrian corridors.
walk_bike.bikeability_summary: The Katy Trail is a popular paved trail through the heart of Dallas. Bikeshare exists in limited areas.
walk_bike.bike_share_notes: LimeBike and BCycle have limited presence in Dallas. Best used for short hops in Uptown or along the Katy Trail.

pickup_soccer.name: Samuell-Grand Soccer Complex
pickup_soccer.access_notes: City of Dallas soccer complex with multiple fields and regular pickup activity.

pickup_soccer.name: Glencoe Park
pickup_soccer.access_notes: Hispanic neighbourhood park with strong informal soccer culture on weekends.

outdoors_day_trips.name: Lake Texoma
outdoors_day_trips.notes: Large reservoir with swimming, fishing, and boat rentals. Popular day trip for cooling off between Texas summer matches.

outdoors_day_trips.name: Fort Worth Stockyards
outdoors_day_trips.notes: Authentic historic cattle yards with longhorn drives, Western bars, and the best Texas experience close to the city.

safety_tips: Dallas and Fort Worth are generally safe in tourist areas — Downtown, Uptown, Deep Ellum, and Sundance Square
Texas heat is serious in June and July — hydrate constantly and seek shade at outdoor events
Use rideshare for late-night travel rather than walking in unfamiliar areas
Arlington outside the entertainment district is suburban — limited walkability, use rideshare
Thunderstorms can develop rapidly in Texas — check weather before outdoor fan events
